# Plan 03 edge cases for the text front end. One input per line; lines starting with # and empty lines are
# skipped. \u{XXXX} stands for that code point (for invisible characters); everything else is literal.
# tools/webgpu/text_reference.py dumps what upstream makes of each line; web/test/text/ compares with it.
